info.desc: To Each... is the second album and debut LP by english band A Certain Ratio, released in 1981 by record label Factory. It is sometimes considered the band's official first album. It was produced by A Certain Ratio and Martin Hannett. The album spent twenty weeks in the UK Independent Chart, peaking at number 1. .

podcast.body: This is a re-edition of A Certain Ratio's 1981 album, phonetically referred to as "Tugee" or "tu H" in the transcript. The original 1981 release was considered a standout album in the Post-Punk genre, which experienced an "incredible year" in 1981. Although perhaps not as widely remembered today as Joy Division, it was a very significant contribution to the Post-Punk scene. "Y se redita a un disco de Acerter in Rathio, tu H, de 1981, 1981 fue uno de los años más increíbles del Postpank y uno de los grandes discos que tuvimos en 1988 fue este Tugee de Acerter in Rathio, que no está recordado ahora mejor como yo de division, pero fue un grandísimo al mundo del Postpank."
